milestone: Bounded preparation of native BF16/F32 parameters in the existing core owner
status: Qualified preparation component; whole inference/vLLM goal remains active

implementation.anatomy: Architecture emits594 typed parameter bindings, with global/layer roles, source IDs, geometry and layout policy. Backend consumes these descriptors without model-family dispatch.
implementation.storage: 534 row-major parameters preserve BF16 or F32 bits;60 BF16 linear matrices become packed FP16 [K,N] using bounded CPU conversion and the existing immutable F16 constructor. Large Engram U8/F16 tables remain outside resident preparation.
implementation.raw_backend: New synchronous immutable raw-row constructor for F16/BF16/F32. One host tile, final GPU allocation only, explicit upload completion before publication, dedicated ownership and direct free. Ordinary matvec/matmul reject these private raw handles.
implementation.publication: Extend SAME model-owned native core container once. Validate all bindings, coverage, extents and aggregate budgets before construction; finite-check every source chunk. Stage parameters separately and publish only on complete success. Failures preserve all existing core handles and metadata.
implementation.scope: Storage policies replay original loader choices: embedding/RMSNorm keep BF16, HC/bias/sink keep F32, ordinary BF16 linear weights become FP16. Derived fused norm copies, centered routing bias variants and numerical operators are not implemented by this preparation step.

validation.reference: Frozen before production changes: original-loader storage-policy replay with Torch BF16-to-FP16 conversion/transpose for linear weights; raw BF16/F32 source bits otherwise. Not execution of complete original module loaders.
validation.synthetic: Raw CUDA byte identity, partial rows, owner/capacity/budget rejection, failed reader/retry, no idle-pool retention; aggregate parameter budgets, constructor failures1/250/594, stable core pointers, one-shot publication; source NaN in raw BF16 embedding, converted BF16 head and final F32 bias rejects while core remains intact.
validation.actual: Every parameter byte and every previously prepared core FP16 word compared after extension, per native/ASAN+UBSAN/memcheck/Nsight run. Two request streams still consume model-owned Q_A correctly,499200 exact outputwords per non-profile run.

memory_profile.scope: 330 core projections plus594 parameters retained in SAME model-owned backend; parameter extension, readback, teardown. Requests skipped in capture.
memory_profile.limitations: Requested payload, not total VRAM. Context/library/static/driver allocations separate. Host staging excludes metadata, page cache, CUDA internal staging and large test/reference buffers. No generation or performance parity claim.

validation.prior_attempts: Initial product build zero warnings; standard source-ownership check caught direct upload-vtable calls in backend_layout. Corrected to public backend helpers, standalone backend matrix passed, added three nonfinite-source rollback tests, then repeated protected clean/product/standard/full CUDA/diagnostics successfully. Initial logs retained in build-initial.

limitations: Native source parameters and core projections are prepared; complete transformer execution and generation remain unfinished.
Engram tables/hash/token-map, HC4/norm/routing and compressed shared/indexed attention operators still require integration.
Some original runtime derived parameter copies remain to be prepared under explicit budgets. No full forward or numerical operator equivalence follows from storage equality.
Budgets cover requested tensor payload and explicit staging, not total VRAM/RSS, library/driver overhead, page cache or large diagnostic buffers.
No new vLLM throughput/decode parity, CPU/NEON/Metal/WASM execution claim.
